, explore the normalization of artificial intelligence education mechanisms in schools by professionals from universities, research institutes, and high-tech enterprises. 
(11) Strengthen research and teaching in artificial intelligence education. Municipal and district educational research departments will incorporate artificial intelligence education into the regular research scope, and in conjunction with the development of "comprehensive educational research," develop innovative guidelines for empowering subject teaching in primary and secondary schools with artificial intelligence, integrating AI technology into the education and teaching of various subjects, promoting curriculum reform, and enhancing teachers' digital literacy and application capabilities. Focusing on key areas such as science education, physical and aesthetic education, and labor education, explore new ideas, plans, and paths for research and teaching work supported by artificial intelligence, targeting important aspects such as teaching design, assignment design, after-school services, and comprehensive practice.
(12) Cultivate and select professional backbone teachers. Implement the "Hundred-Thousand Seed Plan" for all primary and secondary school teachers in the city, attracting teachers from relevant subjects to participate, with a focus on training 100 professional teachers and 1,000 backbone teachers in the field of artificial intelligence education in Beijing in batches, radiating and driving all subject teachers. For teachers who have made outstanding contributions to artificial intelligence education, increase support in areas such as teaching achievement evaluation, professional title assessment, and performance guarantees.
V. Establish a three-dimensional application system for artificial intelligence education.
(13) Empower the integrated cultivation system of the five educations. Explore a scenario-based, immersive, and integrated practical education system empowered by AI that reflects the characteristics of the capital, and continuously deepen the comprehensive reform of the "Great Ideological and Political Course." Utilize technologies such as artificial intelligence and robotics to enrich the "quarter-hour break" activities, supporting the integrated education of in-class, break, and after-class activities.
